This week we're looking at spatial data with emphasis on mapping. We'll be looking at:

 - Polygon maps
 - Simple features
 - Adding points to a map
 - Cooordinate reference systems
 - Raster data

Start by downloading lab04.qmd into your 161307 project folder

<https://www.massey.ac.nz/~jcmarsha/161307/labs/lab04.qmd>

Open your 161307 project in RStudio and then load up `lab04.qmd` and work through the workshop.

**Remember to take lots of notes and to ask questions of the teaching staff if there's anything you find unclear.**
